article.headline: New Orleans knocks off Texas Southern 75-70
article.description: — Kahlil Singleton had 26 points in New Orleans’ 75-70 win against Texas Southern on Saturday.
article.linkText: New Orleans knocks off Texas Southern 75-70

keywords: LSU New Orleans Privateers @ Texas Southern Tigers
article.story: HOUSTON -- — Kahlil Singleton had 26 points in New Orleans’ 75-70 win against Texas Southern on Saturday. Singleton shot 7 for 16 (6 for 14 from 3-point range) and 6 of 7 from the free-throw line for the Privateers (3-2). Kedrick Osby scored 16 points, shooting 6 for 12, including 2 for 4 from beyond the arc. Karris Bilal led the way for the Tigers (1-6) with 20 points and six assists. Jason Kimbrough Jr. added 12 points and two steals for Texas Southern. Bencao Vungo finished with 10 points and eight rebounds. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
